infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CropCapture requires camera access for farm photography and QR code traceability scanning.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CropCapture requires location permissions to record precise GPS coordinates for farm boundaries and field visits.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CropCapture needs photo library access to upload farm, crop, and inspection evidence photos.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CropCapture to use camera for farm and quality inspection photography.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow CropCapture to capture farm GPS coordinates.
